definitions.gloss: once more, again, a second time
definitions.explanation: Doing something one more time. More formal than もう一度 or また, often used in written language, announcements, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {再度|さいど}{確認|かくにん}してください。
{再度|さいど}お{電話|でんわ}いたします。
{問題|もんだい}が{解決|かいけつ}しなかったため、{再度|さいど}{検討|けんとう}することになった。
examples.english: Since the problem was not resolved, it was decided to reconsider the matter.

notes:
A formal alternative to もう{一度|いちど} or また. Common in business communication, official announcements, and written documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{再度|さいど}{確認|かくにん}する (confirm again)
・{再度|さいど}{検討|けんとう}する (reconsider)
・{再度|さいど}お{願|ねが}いする (request again)
・{再度|さいど}{挑戦|ちょうせん}する (try again, make another attempt)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{再度|さいど}: again (formal, written/business tone)
・もう{一度|いちど}: one more time (neutral, everyday)
・また: again (casual, broad usage)
・{改|あらた}めて: anew, afresh (implies starting over properly)
